whole_document_split_plan.conflict: With only one three-or-more-version chain per family, putting at least one document from every family into M1 holdout while forbidding any M2 chain from crossing splits would place every available family chain wholly in holdout and leave no real development chain.
whole_document_split_plan.no_leak_resolution: After the implementation candidate is hash-bound, the independent evaluation owner must select and acquire one additional, disjoint official lineage chain of at least three consecutive versions for each family. Its identities, URLs, raw hashes, split membership, labels and per-case outputs must remain unavailable to implementation until the policy permits reveal.
constraints: split only on whole official documents
never split one standard lineage chain across development and holdout
no raw SHA-256 or derived normalized/excerpt overlap
holdout acquisition and manifest freezing belong to the independent evaluation owner in a fresh environment
any holdout source license, official identity, hash, length, or continuity uncertainty is BLOCKED_EXTERNAL
